comment: Every place in docs/TOWN.md. status: OPEN, EXTERIOR, CLOSED, STORY. kind: building (exterior door), outdoor (a spot on the map), room (inside another interior), home. hours: free parts it is open ('*' = every free part). Changing EXTERIOR to OPEN = set status, add an interior.

locations.name: Hallways
locations.doorLine: The school is locked. The trophy case glints at you through the glass, smug.

activities.label: Eat lunch at an empty table
activities.say: You eat alone and observe the social ecosystem. Field notes: complicated.

locations.name: Gym

activities.label: Lift weights
activities.say: The weights are heavy. That's the point, apparently.

locations.doorLine: The gym is locked. Somewhere inside, a basketball bounces on its own.

activities.label: Run laps
activities.say: You run until the bleachers blur. Coach Byrne would be proud. Quietly.

activities.label: Independent study
activities.say: Ms. G leaves the door open for anyone who wants to stay. She talks the whole time.

activities.label: Read the weather station
activities.say: The readings this week are... leaning somewhere. You write it down.

activities.label: Drama club rehearsal
activities.say: Mr. Mustard gives notes like a weather report: calm, vague, oddly reassuring.

activities.label: Debate club
activities.say: Priya runs it like a war room. You learn three ways to say 'actually'.

locations.name: Shop classroom
locations.doorLine: Locked. The light inside is on anyway. Mr. J's secret project hums.

activities.label: Sketch quietly
activities.say: You draw the room. In your drawing, the shadows are slightly wrong.

locations.name: Teacher's lounge
locations.doorLine: Staff only. Somebody has labeled every single mug.

locations.name: Roof access
locations.doorLine: A padlock, a chain, and a fresh scuff mark on the top step. Someone goes up there.
locations.futureHook: Future secret area; candidate for Sam, Unmasked

locations.name: Boiler room
locations.doorLine: Warm air leaks under the door. It shouldn't be warm.

locations.name: Town square

activities.label: Read the notice board
activities.say: Lost cat. Bake sale. A flyer about the pep rally with one face scratched out.

locations.futureHook: Notice board for side quests, weekly town events

locations.name: Gary's Deli

activities.label: Work a deli shift
activities.say: You slice, you wrap, you learn exactly nothing about the recipe.

locations.doorLine: The sign says CLOSED. The smell says otherwise.

locations.name: Gary's apartment
locations.doorLine: A narrow door beside the deli, with a mail slot full of coupons.
locations.futureHook: Planned interior: old town photos, the recipe safe

locations.name: The alley behind the deli

activities.label: Search the alley
activities.say: Behind a crate: an old photo of the town and a frost-cracked pipe that runs straight into the deli's freezer wall.

locations.lockedLine: You walk right past the gap between the buildings. (PER 7 to notice it.)

locations.name: Town Library

activities.label: Study old town records
activities.say: Ms. Marlowe sets a book in front of you without being asked. It's the right one.

locations.doorLine: Hours are posted in a very precise font. You are outside them.

locations.name: Arcade

activities.label: Play Neon Dodger ($2)
activities.say: High score: DEX. Second place: also DEX, it's the same kid.

locations.doorLine: The arcade's shutter is down. A machine inside plays its attract tune to nobody.
locations.lockedLine: Not yet. Come back in week 2.

activities.label: Volunteer shift with Nurse Patti
activities.say: "Oh, you're the new one. I already heard about you."

effects.narrate: They're in good hands. Patti is already telling them everyone's business.

locations.name: Hospital closed wing
locations.doorLine: AUTHORIZED PERSONNEL ONLY. The paint on the door is newer than the door.
locations.futureHook: Opens with the week 4 story flag; Night Ward source
locations.lockedLine: Not yet. Come back in week 4.

locations.name: Town hall
locations.doorLine: Town hall. A schedule on the door lists 'closed session' for most of the week.
locations.futureHook: Planned interior: Mayor's office, records room (Mr. B evidence later)

locations.name: Bus stop (downtown)
locations.lockedLine: The bus schedule is a blank sheet that says 'NEXT WEEK'.

locations.name: Corner store
locations.doorLine: The door is stuck, but the walk-up window is open. A bell on a string. You ring it.
locations.futureHook: Planned: second shop for snacks and gifts (interior later)
locations.lockedLine: Not yet. Come back in week 3.

locations.name: Movie theater
locations.doorLine: Closed for renovations. The marquee still says the last film's title, but the letters keep changing.

locations.name: Town museum
locations.doorLine: "Reopening soon." The sign has been reopening soon since 1994.
locations.lockedLine: Not yet. Come back in week 3.

locations.name: Post office
locations.doorLine: The post office has a single bench and a single, very tired clerk visible through the glass.

activities.label: Breakfast with your guardian
activities.say: Your guardian is already halfway out the door. Toast is a form of love.

locations.name: Theo's house
locations.doorLine: A telescope in the upstairs window points at the woods, not the sky.

locations.name: Mara's house
locations.doorLine: The garage door is a mural of the town at night. One window in the mural is lit.

locations.name: Dex's house
locations.doorLine: A whoopee cushion sits on the doormat. You step around it. It was a decoy. There's a second one.

locations.name: Jon's house
locations.doorLine: Collectible figures stand guard in every window, posed mid-battle.

locations.name: Kris's house
locations.doorLine: Next door to Jon's. Lights out by 9, always.

locations.name: Jake's house
locations.doorLine: The garage is a graveyard of abandoned hobbies. There's a new anvil out front.

locations.name: Phase's house
locations.doorLine: A basketball hoop, three footballs and a single deli apron on the lawn.

locations.name: Mel's house
locations.doorLine: A note on the door: 'HOMEWORK FIRST.' Underlined twice.

locations.name: Diane's house
locations.doorLine: Very tidy. The mailbox is labeled with a label maker. So is the label maker.

locations.name: Kara's house
locations.doorLine: Pom-poms drying on the porch rail.

locations.name: Kayla's house
locations.doorLine: A porch swing, gently moving. There's no wind.

locations.name: Todd's house
locations.doorLine: The lights are never on. Nobody ever sees Todd leave or arrive.

locations.name: A very normal house
locations.doorLine: The most normal house on the street. On purpose. You can tell.

locations.name: Elm Street Apartments
locations.doorLine: A nameplate panel by the door lists every resident. Somebody has drawn a tiny sun next to Mr. Mustard's name.

locations.name: Coach Byrne's house
locations.doorLine: Trophies in the window. A tractor tire in the yard that has clearly been flipped today.

locations.name: Ms. G's house
locations.doorLine: A homemade antenna on the roof hums a note just below hearing.

locations.name: Mr. J's house
locations.doorLine: The garage light is on. Something inside goes clank... clank... clank.

locations.name: Ms. Nonsense's house
locations.doorLine: Immaculate lawn. A 'No Soliciting' sign, and under it a second sign: 'I Mean It.'

locations.name: Kelly's house
locations.doorLine: Big, quiet and too clean. The doorbell plays three notes, then stops politely.

locations.name: Priya's house
locations.doorLine: Debate trophies in the window, arranged by year and margin of victory.

locations.name: Baxter's house
locations.doorLine: Hedges trimmed into perfect cubes. One cube is slightly less perfect. Penny did it.

locations.name: Penny's house
locations.doorLine: Next door to Baxter's. Both of them hate this.

locations.name: Sam's family estate
locations.doorLine: A big iron gate with an intercom. It says nothing. It is listening.
locations.futureHook: Planned interior; possible link to Sam, Unmasked

locations.name: Mayor's residence
locations.doorLine: A campaign sign on the lawn from three elections ago, still smiling.

locations.name: Mr. B's house
locations.doorLine: The curtains are always drawn. The doormat says WELCOME in a font that does not mean it.

locations.name: Dr. Reyes's house
locations.doorLine: Her study light is on late. Always.

locations.name: The blacksmith's forge

activities.label: Work the bellows
activities.say: "Took you long enough." The forge breathes when you do.

locations.doorLine: The forge is banked for the night. Still warm. Always warm.

locations.name: Blacksmith's cottage
locations.doorLine: A horseshoe over the door, upside down. 'Keeps the luck IN,' says a note.

activities.label: Sit very still and listen
activities.say: The woods breathe. Somebody nearby is narrating your every move. Out loud.

locations.name: Bus stop (outskirts)
locations.lockedLine: The bus schedule is a blank sheet that says 'NEXT WEEK'.

locations.name: The Rift
locations.lockedLine: Just a crack in the air behind the lot. Not yet.
locations.doorLine: A tear in the air behind the abandoned lot, humming like a fridge.

activities.label: Step into the Rift (the rest of After School)
activities.say: The Rift pulls you through. It smells like a gym and a thunderstorm.

locations.name: Abandoned lot
locations.doorLine: A chain-link fence and a hand-painted sign: KEEP OUT. The grass inside grows in a circle.
locations.futureHook: Secret area; hints at the Upside-Down's origin

locations.name: Train station
locations.doorLine: Service suspended until further notice. The departures board still flickers.
locations.futureHook: Leaving town, new regions, Todd's disappearances (maybe)

locations.name: Abandoned mansion
locations.doorLine: The gate is chained. The mansion watches the town from the hill like it's waiting for its cue.
locations.futureHook: Deep Upside-Down history and Mr. B's past

locations.name: Old factory
locations.doorLine: Fenced off. A sign: DANGER. Under it, smaller: SERIOUSLY.

locations.name: Water tower
locations.doorLine: The ladder is locked. Someone has painted an eye at the top. It wasn't there yesterday.

locations.name: Cemetery
locations.doorLine: The gate is chained. Some of the newer stones have no dates.
locations.futureHook: Names of people the Upside-Down took

locations.name: Lake and boathouse
locations.doorLine: "Swimming season closed." The lake is very still. Too still.

locations.name: The bleachers
locations.futureHook: M13: a hangout and nap spot

napSpotsNote: Where '@nap' schedules (Sam, Kris) can be found, one per day (M13 moved this list out of the script).
